cases.description: Y02 PendulumLab packaged through the REAL editor path and run from another directory (App Platform catalog): Projects/PendulumLab is copied OUTSIDE the SDK source tree (build/apq1-y02-external), packaged by Starforge.exe + X01PackageSelfTest (OpenProjectPath -> PackageProject -> BuildRunner cmake configure + Release build of the external project against COSMIC_SDK -> Packager::Stage/Finalize -> dist/PendulumLab with the renamed exe, Cosmic.dll, PendulumLab.dll, assets, boot.cfg), then the STAGED PendulumLab.exe is started from a different working directory with COSMIC_Y02_SELFTEST (Y02SelfTestService: Home -> Lab -> Settings -> Lab -> key:Escape -> Home through the real FlowMachine; pendulum.angle_deg changing on a monotone bus clock; PhasePlot hosted-panel draws > 0; the UiPlot rect read back from the framebuffer contains line-colour pixels; verdict JSON, PASS exits 0). The wrapper's out-of-process oracle checks the trace, the draw count, the plot pixels, the angle sweep, the producer, the cwd (scratch, not dist), the user_root under the isolated COSMIC_USER_DATA and decodes the ROI PNG. Three verdicts: package, packaged run, oracle. The packaged app under test is the Release build in both configurations (the packager builds Release).
